in_hebrew.name: Upton
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Farmstead or weeping town
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Upton הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English 'upp-tun', meaning a 'higher farmstead' or 'weeping town'. The name Upton may have originated as a place name and was later used as a personal name.
